title: Design: the dark bar, row channels, footer and button
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View' and 'Customers — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on Default for work orders and Default for Part Sales.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, on Default for work orders and Default for Part Sales.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Click the Customers tab.
  4. Click Manage Customers.
  5. Tick customer A.
  6. Tick customer B.
  7. Untick Part Sales on customer B's row.
  8. Click Add 2 Customers.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows tier A.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The Customers tab shows.

Step 4:

  • The dialog opens.

Step 5:

  • A dark bar appears above the search with a count chip and "selected".

Step 6:

  • The bar reads 2 selected, Select All with the list's count, a checked Work Orders box, a checked Part Sales box and an X, in that order.
  • Ticked rows have a light blue background and show Work Orders and Part Sales checkboxes; the footer reads "Adding 2 customers: 2 for both." and the blue button "Add 2 Customers", as in picture 9.6.

Step 7:

  • The bar's Part Sales box shows a dash (mixed).
  • The footer reads "Adding 2 customers: 1 for both, 1 for Work Orders only."
  • The layout matches picture 9.7.

Step 8:

  • The dialog closes; a white message reads "2 customers added to" tier A's name, with "New work orders and Part Sales use" tier A's name ". Existing ones keep their prices and tier.", as in picture 9.15.
